extension.summary: Synchronised Plex playback with friends in PM4K
extension.description: Watch Party synchronises Plex playback in PM4K across devices, so friends in different places can watch together. Start a watch party and invite people: playback starts, pauses and skips for everyone at the same time. Requires a Watch Party server and a connection code from its administrator.
extension.news: v0.3.20 - When two people skip within a second of each other, the later skip now wins on every device. Before, one device could send the earlier skip after the later one and leave the party out of step. - Messages read better with several people and devices: one person's two offline devices read "Sam is offline", and the device hosting the party is told "You are in your watch party". v0.3.19 - A skip made while the connection briefly dropped is shared once it is back, so the others still follow you. - Skipping twice quickly over a slow connection no longer moves your player back to the first spot for a moment. - A skip reported late by Kodi still puts everyone in step with you, also when you are the only one watching the title. - No "seconds ahead" offer while a slow connection holds back the report of your skip. - A pause that reached everyone is no longer said to be on this device only when its reply was lost. - Skipping while "Syncing" plays from where you skipped, instead of staying paused. - Pressing play during a countdown while Watch Party cannot be reached now says it paused on this device only, instead of nothing. v0.3.18 - Skipping several times in a row over a slow connection no longer sets every device skipping back and forth between earlier spots. Watch Party now recognises its own moves even when Kodi reports them seconds late. - No more "seconds behind" or "seconds ahead" offers right after a skip. - A skip Kodi reports late is shared from where your player really is, so everyone lands in step with you. - A device that cannot stop exactly where it is sent, such as a TV box, now starts from where it stopped once everyone has agreed to start there, instead of trying again and again. - Someone watching on several devices is named once, and one of those devices closing the video is said once instead of at every change. - A notice shown while the video was paused moves back up into the corner when it plays on, instead of staying lower. v0.3.17 - A disconnected device now says it needs a new connection code from your Watch Party administrator, as the old one no longer works. v0.3.16 - Pressing Join while Watch Party cannot be reached now says so, instead of nothing happening. The invitation waits in the Watch Party menu. - People's pictures in the WebP format are shown. - Small fixes: the next episode of a show without season numbers is named correctly, and too many requests at once are explained. v0.3.15 - Putting Kodi into standby right after joining a watch party from the Watch Party menu now leaves that watch party, as standby always does. Before, the device could stay in it and keep itself online. - A shortcut recorded on F1 to F12 or the number pad is named correctly, instead of as a letter. v0.3.14 - A skip made with Kodi's own controls (the keyboard or a remote on a PC) is shared from where it goes. Kodi still reported the old time at that moment, so the skip was shared from where you had been and the others never moved. - A skip of your own seconds after Watch Party moved your player is no longer mistaken for Watch Party's own move. - Watch Party starts itself again after an unexpected error, instead of stopping until Kodi restarts, and its errors no longer reach Kodi as script errors. - Small fixes: a record of invitations kept growing, and a question that could not be shown kept a timer running. v0.3.13 - An invitation left unanswered, or still on screen when Kodi closes, no longer counts as Not now, and no longer ends in "That invitation is no longer open" ten minutes later. - An invitation question closes by itself once the invitation is gone: joined on another of your devices, ended, or expired. - Invited again while the question is still open shows one question, not two. - Connecting again no longer makes Watch Party briefly think it is offline, which could drop a press of play or pause, and the old connection now ends at once. - A skip made with PM4K just after following someone else's skip is no longer mistaken for Watch Party's own jump: it is shared with everyone, instead of leaving this device seconds behind. - Season and episode stay together on one line. v0.3.12 - Questions and messages open in Watch Party's own window, in the style of its menu and the same on every skin: invitations, updates, leaving or ending a watch party, disconnecting and choosing a shortcut. Questions that cannot be undone start on Cancel. - While playback is paused, Watch Party's messages sit below the bar Kodi shows at the top instead of over it. - A long message no longer starts a line with a separator dot. v0.3.11 - A new menu: wider, the same on every skin, with where you stand at the top, each option's setting on the right and an explanation of the selected option at the bottom. Do not disturb switches right in the menu.

extension.description: Install this once. Kodi then keeps Watch Party up to date by itself.
